spans.s: ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व) (I) a. (f. र्ध्वा) 1. Rising upwards, elevated; 2. high, superior; 3. not sitting; 4. torn (as hair).
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व) (II) n. Elevation, height.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-कच (I) m. an epithet of Ketu.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-कच (II) a. one whose hair is torn.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-कर्मन् n. 1. motion upwards; 2. action for attaining a high place.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-काय n. the upper part of the body.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-गति (I) f. ascent, elevation.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-गति (II) a. going upwards.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-चरण (I) a. having the feet upwards.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-चरण (II) m. a fabulous beast called Śarabha.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-जानु, -ज्ञ, -ज्ञु a. 1. raising the knees; 2. long-shanked.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-जानु, -ज्ञ, -ज्ञु a. 1. raising the knees; 2. long-shanked.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-जानु, -ज्ञ, -ज्ञु a. 1. raising the knees; 2. long-shanked.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-दृष्टि (I) a. 1. looking upwards; 2. aspiring.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-दृष्टि (II) f. concentration of the sight on the spot between the eyebrows (in Yoga phil.).
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-देह m. a funeral ceremony.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-पातन n. sublimation.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-पाद f. having the heels upwards.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-रेतस् (I) a. one who abstains from sexual intercourse, one who lives in perpetual chastity.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-रेतस् (II) m. 1. Śiva; 2. Bhīṣma.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-मौहूर्तुक a. happening after a short time.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-लोक m. the upper world, i.e. heaven.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-वात f. the wind in the upper part of the body.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-शायिन् (I) a. sleeping with upturned face (as a child).
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-शायिन् (II) m. Śiva.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-श्वास m. expiration.
ऊर्ध्व(र्द्ध्व)-स्थिति f. 1. a horse’s back; 2. elevation, superiority.
